freeze_order_proof: This prereg is committed BEFORE backtest/tools/trendline_context_conditioning_2026_08_01.py exists. Verify: the commit introducing this file predates the commit introducing the runner (git log --follow on both paths).
question: Does multi-day trendline CONTEXT (backtest/autoresearch/trendline_engine.py lines, wick+body families) CHANGE the per-trade expectancy of the engine's PROFITABLE level-anchored entry cohort? Conditioning only -- re-slices existing real-OPRA trades; invents NO new entries.
graveyard_compliance: trendline_reclaim / wick_reclaim as STANDALONE triggers are graveyard (n=27, -$40.64/tr, day-level p=0.0007) and are NOT retested here. This tests the one untested form: trendline events as CONTEXT/score-contributor input on level-anchored setups (C15: gates interact multiplicatively).

population.anchor_check: Runner MUST reproduce n=66 and sum(dollar_pnl)=+$6,894.85 to the cent before any cell is computed; mismatch = abort.
population.provenance: Real-OPRA replay P&L only (use_real_fills=True; 16 no-OPRA-cache entries were already excluded by the replay itself, disclosed there). Zero synthetic P&L anywhere in this study. Replay window 2025-01-02..2026-07-22 is a subset of the VERIFIED 391-day population (2025-01-02..2026-07-31). The 2024 OPRA backfill range is NOT touched (analysis/deep-research/OPRA-BACKFILL-2026-07-31.md absent = backfill not declared complete).
population.no_regression_note: This study modifies nothing; the sacred runner cohort (35 winners +$15,774) is untouched by construction (read-only re-slice).

context_computation.detector: trendline_engine.detect(bars, families=('wick','body'), include_same_day_tier=True) -- SAME code path as production Gamma_Trendlines main(); zoom_class irrelevant (not requested).
context_computation.bars_source: backtest/data/spy_5m_2025-01-01_2026-07-22.csv -- the replay's OWN bar file (SPY_FILE in engine_fullhist_replay.py), so trade timestamps and bar timestamps share one frame by construction.
context_computation.frame_discipline: File stores fixed -04:00 labels (wall-v1, backtest/lib/et_frame.py doctrine). entry_time_et in the replay JSON is naive wall-v1 from the same producer. ALL comparisons are naive label-vs-label within this single frame -- no cross-frame join, no et-v2 mixing (DST-frame artifact C6/L14 compliance).
context_computation.rth_filter: Per-date RTH window in wall-v1 labels: [10:30,17:00) on EST dates, [09:30,16:00) on EDT dates, offset per setup/scripts/et_clock.et_offset_hours (the one DST authority). This drops premarket bars present in the cache for later dates.
context_computation.lookback: For each trade: all RTH bars of the 5 trading days strictly before entry date (trading days = dates present in the bar file), PLUS same-day RTH bars with bar_start_label < entry_time_et. The last bar in the window is the trigger/decision bar (closed at fill per entry+1, ENTRY-BAR-CONVENTION-RULING-2026-07-25). NO bar at-or-after entry_time_et is ever passed to the detector (no look-ahead).
context_computation.lookback_truncation_disclosure: Entries within the first 5 trading days of the file (which starts 2025-01-02) get a truncated lookback; the runner reports how many trades have <5 prior days. We do NOT reach into 2024 bar files (frame seam at the 2024/2025 file boundary is a known corruption source).
context_computation.reference_price: ref = close of the trigger bar (last bar of the lookback window). Runner also records trade trigger_level for descriptive comparison.
context_computation.active_line: A detected line counts as ACTIVE iff status in {INTACT, TESTING} evaluated on the lookback window (status is computed by _fit on the window's last bar). BROKEN lines are excluded from alignment/opposition (a broken line is no longer standing structure).
context_computation.live_parity_caveat: Live engine refits every 5 min on a rolling window ending now (IEX feed); study refits at trigger-bar close on the SIP/IEX cache patchwork (DATA-PROVENANCE.md). Same detector code, same N_DAYS=5, same families. Feed seams disclosed, not resolved here.

cell_definitions.band_provenance: Primary $1.00 = the standing carry-proximity doctrine distance ('within $1 of a Carry level'); NOT hand-fit to this data. $0.50/$2.00 are halving/doubling sensitivity cells declared up front. ANY-distance is the no-knob existence variant.

aligned.bull_C: exists ACTIVE support line with ref - B <= current_value <= ref + TOL (support at/below price within band)
aligned.bear_P: exists ACTIVE resistance line with ref - TOL <= current_value <= ref + B (rail at/above price within band)

opposing.bull_C: exists ACTIVE resistance line with ref - TOL <= current_value <= ref + B (overhead rail the trade buys into)
opposing.bear_P: exists ACTIVE support line with ref - B <= current_value <= ref + TOL (defended floor the trade shorts into)

cell_definitions.per_cell_reporting: n, total $, $/trade, WR, plus overlap count with the intraday 'trendline_rejection' trigger tag (7/66 trades carry it -- a DIFFERENT single-day detector; disclosed per cell so the two mechanisms are never conflated).

contrasts: C1: any-ALIGNED vs not-ALIGNED (binary over cohort)
C2: any-OPPOSING vs not-OPPOSING (binary over cohort)
strata: R2026 (trades dated >= 2026-01-01; recent window FIRST-CLASS, expected n~35)
contrasts_and_stats.test_count: 2 contrasts x 2 strata x 4 band variants = 16 tests
contrasts_and_stats.statistic: difference in mean dollar_pnl per trade (cell minus complement)
contrasts_and_stats.test: two-sided permutation test, 20000 permutations, python random.Random(seed=42), label-shuffle within the stratum; p = (1 + #{|perm_diff| >= |obs_diff|}) / (1 + 20000)
contrasts_and_stats.degenerate_cells: cell n < 3 or complement n < 3 => p not computed (reported as NaN, excluded from the BH set, disclosed with m)
contrasts_and_stats.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across ALL non-degenerate p-values of the 16, q* = 0.10. ALL cells and ALL p-values reported regardless of outcome.
contrasts_and_stats.day_level_robustness: For each surviving contrast: day-summed P&L version reported (trades aggregated per day, same permutation scheme on days). Robustness disclosure only, not a gate.
contrasts_and_stats.wr_reported: Win rates per cell reported descriptively; NOT tested (avoids doubling the test count).

decision_rule_frozen.SIGNAL: At least one of the 16 tests survives BH-FDR at q*=0.10 AND that contrast's effect sign is the SAME in the R2026 stratum (point estimate direction match; R2026 significance not required) AND the smaller side of the surviving contrast has n >= 10.
decision_rule_frozen.on_SIGNAL: PROPOSE (never arm) a score-contributor wiring: write a follow-up prereg spec for trendline-context as a score term on level-anchored setups. No engine/params/gate change ships from THIS study.
decision_rule_frozen.on_NULL: Declare the trendline program VISIBILITY-ONLY (the WS8 visibility surface ships regardless) and stop -- no further trendline-entry research without new evidence class.
decision_rule_frozen.no_third_option: Cherry-picking a non-surviving cell for a 'soft propose' is forbidden.

disclosures_frozen_up_front: n=66 is small; cells will be smaller. This is a conditioning read on an already-selected profitable cohort -- selection into the cohort (structure-stop resolution) is upstream of and independent from the trendline context being tested, but ANY finding is hypothesis-generating for wiring, never arming evidence.
The cohort is 100% structure-stop trades; premium-stop (TL_only, -$1,830/124tr) trades are OUT of population by design -- this study cannot say anything about them.
7/66 trades already carry the intraday trendline_rejection trigger tag; overlap reported per cell.

Multi-day engine lines did not EXIST as a live surface for most of the replay window (engine built 2026-06-26, multi-day 2026-07-08) -- context is computed retrospectively by running today's detector code on historical bars. This is exactly what a score-contributor would do at decision time with the same bars, so the retrospective computation is mechanism-faithful (same code, same no-look-ahead window).
Bar cache is a SIP/IEX patchwork (DATA-PROVENANCE.md); trendline geometry from cached bars may differ marginally from what the live IEX-fed engine would have drawn on those days.
entry_time_et for 4 trades on 2026-07-17 was anchor-verified against live journal fills by the replay itself (sanity_anchors); no independent re-anchoring here.
sibling_deliverable_not_gated_by_this_st: WS8 visibility: automation/state/trendline-watch.json producer + one premarket brief line. Ships regardless of study outcome.
